segmentHeight.$description: Height of each segment in the Segments meter.

underlineHeight.$description: Thickness of the meter drawn along the field's bottom edge.

barMinimum.$description: Smallest visible fill (as a fraction) once anything is typed, so the bar and underline never look broken.

pauseDelay.$description: After a pause: how long typing must stop before the meter updates.

announceDelay.$description: How long typing must stop before screen readers hear the new strength.
